summary: The midpoint estimate holds for all real pairs, including identical endpoints, by subadditivity of the positive power with exponent alpha_q. For every fixed q and finite K, the stated choice of m forces the interior root value to exceed 3K while convexity and the endpoint upper bounds force every proposed majorant below 3K at that same integer. This covers all positive convex majorants and hence affine ones, and the defects tend to zero. The displayed body is compact, convex, and has nonempty ambient interior, with exactly the stated positive integer support and unscaled root-volume normalization for every d >= 1. The short-interval observations and actual-volume inequality are also valid. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
